timing: After frozen image feature extraction; first mass evaluation stopped at boundary validation before any fold predictions or results.
reason: Protocol v1 incorrectly treated dependency_block as a disjoint fitting boundary. Original research uses record-level similarity_component purging for fitting and broader group-union dependency blocks for bootstrap uncertainty. One block joins 18 groups and crosses all five original folds. Original research protocol was reread to verify this distinction.
fitting_boundaries: original image SHA256 across either image role
dependency_block_policy: Report overlap; retain blocks for bootstrap uncertainty. Do not claim independence of these broader blocks across fitting boundaries.
unchanged: All original episodes, 524 records, 50-label budgets, features, grids, metrics, gates and raw image hashes. No relabeling, exclusion or feature re-extraction.
interpretation: Retrospective comparison on original purged development folds, not new-serving or dependency-block-held-out generalization.
